title: Bank Customer Churn Prediction: Machine Learning Model with TensorFlow

cues.en: -: Okay, off we go.
cues.zh: 好，我們開始。

cues.en: So this dataset has got a few columns.
cues.zh: 這個資料集有幾個欄位。

cues.en: It's got row number, customer ID, surname.
cues.zh: 包括列編號、客戶 ID 和姓氏。

cues.en: So what we're looking at is a dataset of a bank.
cues.zh: 我們現在看到的是一家銀行的資料集。

cues.en: Of course, it's all fictional, it's not a real bank.
cues.zh: 當然，這全是虛構的，不是真實銀行。

cues.en: But it's very realistic.
cues.zh: 不過情境非常貼近現實。

cues.en: And here we've got a snapshot of...
cues.zh: 這裡記錄了某個時間點的資料。

cues.en: If you scroll down to the bottom, there's gotta be 10,000 customers.
cues.zh: 捲到最下面，可以看到總共有 10,000 位客戶。

cues.en: So 10,000 rows in this dataset.
cues.zh: 所以這個資料集有 10,000 列。

cues.en: And what the bank did is, they measured some things about these customers, right?
cues.zh: 銀行量測、記錄了這些客戶的某些資訊。

cues.en: Why did they undergo this whole thing?
cues.zh: 為什麼要做這件事？

cues.en: And what's the challenge here?
cues.zh: 這次的挑戰又是什麼？

cues.en: Well, the bank has been seeing unusual churn rates.
cues.zh: 因為銀行發現客戶流失率異常。

cues.en: So churn is when people leave the company.
cues.zh: 所謂 churn，就是客戶離開公司。

cues.en: And they're seeing customers leaving at unusually high rates and they want to understand what the problem is, and they want to assess and address that problem.
cues.zh: 這家銀行的客戶以異常高的比例流失，他們想了解問題，也想評估並解決它。

cues.en: And that's why they've hired you to look into this dataset for them and give them some insights.
cues.zh: 所以請你分析這份資料集，提供一些洞見。

cues.en: And how did this dataset come to be?
cues.zh: 這份資料集是怎麼產生的？

cues.en: Well, six months ago, the bank said, "All right, there's a big problem.
cues.zh: 六個月前，銀行說：「目前有一個嚴重問題。

cues.en: We gotta take a sample of our customers."
cues.zh: 我們必須抽樣觀察一些客戶。」

cues.en: By the way, this is a sample.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，這確實只是樣本。

cues.en: 10,000 is a tiny number for this bank.
cues.zh: 對這家銀行而言，10,000 人是很小的數字。

cues.en: This bank has millions of customers.
cues.zh: 他們有數百萬位客戶。

cues.en: This fictional bank operates in Europe, in three countries France, Spain, and Germany.
cues.zh: 這家虛構銀行在歐洲三個國家營運：法國、西班牙與德國。

cues.en: And they have lots and lots of customers.
cues.zh: 客戶非常多。

cues.en: So what they did is, they took this sample of 10,000 customers and they've measured six months ago everything they knew about them, their customer ID, their surname, credit score,
cues.zh: 他們抽出 10,000 位客戶的樣本，並在六個月前記錄所知的所有資訊，包括客戶 ID、姓氏、信用評分、

cues.en: their geography, their gender, their age, their tenure, so how long they've been with the bank, the balance of the customers at that point in time,
cues.zh: 所在地、性別、年齡、往來年資，也就是成為銀行客戶多久，以及當時的帳戶餘額，

cues.en: the number of products they had at that point in time, so the number of products is things like how many products do they have?
cues.zh: 還有當時使用的產品數。產品數是指哪些呢？

cues.en: Do they have a savings account?
cues.zh: 例如是否有儲蓄帳戶，

cues.en: Do they have a credit card?
cues.zh: 是否有信用卡，

cues.en: Do they have a loan?
cues.zh: 是否有貸款。

cues.en: Did the customer have a credit card or not?
cues.zh: 另外也記錄客戶是否持有信用卡。

cues.en: So there's a Yes/No Flag.
cues.zh: 所以這是一個是或否的旗標。

cues.en: Is the customer an active member?
cues.zh: 客戶是否為活躍會員？

cues.en: Another Yes/No Flag.
cues.zh: 這又是另一個是或否的旗標。

cues.en: Active member can be measured differently by different organizations.
cues.zh: 不同組織對活躍會員的衡量方式可能不同。

cues.en: It could be whether or not the customer logged in to their online banking in the past month, whether they did a transaction in the past two months, or some other measure like that.
cues.zh: 例如過去一個月是否登入網路銀行、過去兩個月是否有交易，或其他類似指標。

cues.en: And estimated salary.
cues.zh: 還有估計薪資。

cues.en: So the bank doesn't know the salary of the customers, but based on the other things they know, they could estimate a salary for that customer.
cues.zh: 銀行不知道客戶的實際薪資，但可以根據其他已知資訊估計。

cues.en: And they also gave you this information.
cues.zh: 這個資訊也提供給你。

cues.en: So six months ago, they measured all of these things and said, "All right, so for these 10,000 randomly selected customers, we're going to just watch them.
cues.zh: 六個月前，他們記錄完上述資訊後決定：「接下來就觀察這 10,000 位隨機抽出的客戶。

cues.en: So we're just gonna wait six months.
cues.zh: 等待六個月，

cues.en: And six months on the track, we're going to check who of those customers left, and whom of those customers stayed."
cues.zh: 六個月後，再確認哪些客戶離開、哪些客戶留下。」

cues.en: And that's what this column exited represents here.
cues.zh: 這就是這裡 Exited 欄位代表的意思。

cues.en: It tells you whether or not the person left the bank within those six months.
cues.zh: 它告訴你，這個人是否在這六個月內離開銀行。

cues.en: So this person over here, sometime within the six months he left the bank.
cues.zh: 例如這位客戶，在六個月內某個時間點離開了。

cues.en: And as of a couple of days ago, he's no longer with the bank.
cues.zh: 截至幾天前，他已經不是這家銀行的客戶。

cues.en: This person over here, on the other hand, is still with the bank, so there's a zero here.
cues.zh: 另一方面，這位客戶仍然留下，所以值是 0。

cues.en: This person left the bank, this person stayed, and so on.
cues.zh: 這位離開，那位留下，依此類推。

cues.en: So if you see a one, that means the person's no longer for bank.
cues.zh: 所以看到 1，表示已經不是銀行的客戶。

cues.en: A zero person's still for bank.
cues.zh: 0 則表示仍然是客戶。

cues.en: And your goal is to create a geodemographic segmentation model to tell the bank which of their customers are at highest risk of leaving.
cues.zh: 你的目標是建立地理與人口統計分群模型，告訴銀行哪些客戶最有可能流失。

cues.en: What I wanted to mention today is that for a lot of customer centric organization, this is gonna be valuable.
cues.zh: 今天我想強調，這對很多以客戶為中心的組織都很有價值。

cues.en: So I've done this personally, I've done this so many times.
cues.zh: 我自己就做過很多次。

cues.en: It is such a value-add to any customer centric organization.
cues.zh: 它能替這類組織增加很大的價值。

cues.en: So whenever an organization deals with customers, this is a lot of value-add.
cues.zh: 只要組織需要與客戶互動，這種分析就很有幫助。

cues.en: And then the other thing is that this skill that you're going to learn is very transferable.
cues.zh: 另外，你將學到的技能也非常容易移轉到其他情境。

cues.en: It doesn't have to be for a bank, it doesn't have to be for churn rates, geodemographic segmentation models can be applied to millions of scenario.
cues.zh: 不一定只能用於銀行或客戶流失率，地理與人口統計分群模型能用在非常多種情況。

cues.en: So here for instance, even in a bank, the same scenario could work, should the person get a loan or not?
cues.zh: 例如同樣在銀行，也可以用來判斷是否應該核發貸款。

cues.en: Should the person be approved for credit or not?
cues.zh: 是否應該核准這個人的信用申請？

cues.en: And once again, you'd have a binary outcome.
cues.zh: 這同樣是二元結果。

cues.en: So based on prior experience, you would know whether or not a person's reliable.
cues.zh: 根據過去經驗，你會知道這個人是否可靠。

cues.en: And you would build a model and say, "Which people are more likely to be reliable and which people are more likely to default."
cues.zh: 再建立模型，判斷哪些人比較可能可靠、哪些人比較可能違約。

cues.en: And that could govern the bank's decision on whether or not to give loans.
cues.zh: 這就能作為銀行決定是否放款的依據。

cues.en: This could be in terms of fraudulent transactions not even in a bank, in a different financial institution.
cues.zh: 也可以用於詐欺交易，不一定是銀行，其他金融機構也可以。

cues.en: You could find out which transactions are more likely to be fraudulent, which are less likely.
cues.zh: 判斷哪些交易比較可能是詐欺，哪些比較不可能。

cues.en: There's lots of scenarios where you could apply a geodemographic segmentation model.
cues.zh: 有很多情境都能使用地理與人口統計分群模型。

cues.en: And it doesn't even have to be geodemographic.
cues.zh: 甚至不一定需要地理或人口統計資料。

cues.en: So whenever you have a scenario when you have a binary outcome and you have lots of independent variables, you can build a proper robust model.
cues.zh: 只要情境是二元結果，而且有很多自變數，就能建立適當而穩健的模型。

cues.en: And that'll tell you which factors influence the outcome.
cues.zh: 它能告訴你，哪些因素會影響結果。

cues.en: So you can apply this knowledge that you're going to learn in any kind of scenario where you have a binary outcome and lots of independent variables.
cues.zh: 所以接下來學到的知識，可以用於任何具有二元結果與多個自變數的情境。
